// Helper: get skills for a given grade + subject
export const getSkillsFor = (grade, subject) =>
  Object.values(SKILLS).filter(s => s.grade === grade && s.subject === subject);

// Helper: get all skills for a grade
export const getAllSkillsForGrade = (grade) =>
  Object.values(SKILLS).filter(s => s.grade === grade);
